name: ecocard
description: Aplicație locală pentru dictare și raportare ecocardiografică
author: Raport Eco

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.package:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win portable
scripts.test:parser: tsc -p tsconfig.parser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.audio.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.eval:dictation: tsc -p tsconfig.parser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.audio.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/eval-dictation.mjs
